quote: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may not proceed on or through any private or public property to enter the intersecting street where traffic is not facing a red signal to avoid the red signal.

activation.source_clause: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone

judgment_calls_needed.note: Avoidance purpose is separately sourced; route shape alone does not establish intent.
